sections.basic_hint: How the product appears on bills and in search.
sections.pricing_hint: Prices are for one pack (one piece when the pack size is 1).
sections.tax_hint: Pick the HSN code — Kadai suggests the usual GST rate.
sections.units_hint: How the product is counted, weighed or sold loose.
sections.inventory_hint: Stock alerts, batches & expiry and weighing scale.
sections.barcodes_hint: Scan the barcode printed on the pack, or let Kadai make one.

form.no_changes: Nothing to save — no changes made.
form.stale: Someone else changed this product. Reload to see the latest details.
form.opening_failed: Product saved, but the opening stock could not be posted. Add it from Stock adjustments.
form.variants_failed: Product saved, but the sizes / colours were not created. Add them below.
form.new_hint: Only the name and selling price are required — fill the rest when you have time.
form.not_found_hint: It may have been deleted. Search the product list again.
form.deactivated: “{{name}}” deactivated — it no longer shows in billing
form.delete_description: A product that was already billed or stocked cannot be deleted — it will be deactivated instead.
form.deactivated_instead: “{{name}}” is used in bills or stock, so it was deactivated instead
form.variant_of: This is a size / colour of
form.read_only: You can view this product. Ask the owner for permission to change it.

basic.name_ta_hint: Printed on Tamil bills and labels.
basic.aliases_hint: Words customers and staff use — Tanglish or short names (arisi, paruppu). Press Enter after each.
basic.aliases_placeholder: Type a word and press Enter
basic.is_service_hint: Tailoring, repair, delivery — no stock is kept.
basic.has_variants_hint: Create one product and add its sizes & colours below.

pricing.per_pack: Prices are for one pack of {{count}} {{unit}}.
pricing.includes_tax_on: The selling price already has GST in it (most shops).
pricing.includes_tax_off: GST is added on top of the selling price in the bill.
pricing.purchase_hint: Cost per pack before GST — used for profit.
pricing.min_price_hint: Billing staff cannot go below this.
pricing.max_discount_hint: Highest discount allowed on this item.
pricing.allow_above_mrp: Selling price above MRP is correct
pricing.allow_above_mrp_hint: Tick only if the printed MRP is old or wrong.
pricing.savings_hint: Against MRP — printed as “You saved” on bills
pricing.slab_rate: GST at this price: {{rate}} (by the rule “{{rule}}”).

tax.hsn_search: Type a code (1006) or a word (rice)
tax.hsn_empty: No match — type the full 4, 6 or 8 digit code
tax.no_slab_rule: No — same GST at any price
tax.slab_rule_hint: For clothes and footwear whose GST changes with the price.
tax.rate_fallback: Used when no price slab applies.
tax.suggested_applied: Usual GST {{rate}} applied — please check with your auditor if unsure.
tax.suggested_slab: GST depends on the price — choose a price-based GST rule below.
tax.suggested_check: GST depends on the item — please choose the rate.

units.pack_size_hint: How many {{units}} in one pack (strip of 10 tablets → 10).
units.decimal_qty_hint: For weighed or measured items (1.25 kg, 2.5 m).
units.decimal_qty_off: This unit is counted in whole numbers only.
units.locked_hint: The unit and pack size cannot change once the product has stock entries.
units.loose_on: Billing can sell single {{units}}; stock shows full packs and loose ones.

inventory.parent_note: Stock is kept for each size / colour separately.
inventory.track_hint: Stock goes down on every bill and up on every purchase.
inventory.batches_hint: Track batch number and expiry date for each purchase.
inventory.batches_pharmacy: Needed for medicines — oldest expiry is billed first.
inventory.reorder_level_hint: Warn me when stock falls to this.
inventory.weighed_hint: Price-label scales print barcodes with this item code.
inventory.scale_plu_hint: The item number set in the weighing scale.
inventory.opening_hint: Stock you have now in {{store}}, valued at the purchase price.
inventory.opening_batches_note: This product has batches — add its opening stock with batch and expiry from Stock adjustments.

barcodes.case_hint: For a box barcode, set how many pieces one scan adds (box of 12 → 12).
barcodes.duplicate: This barcode is already in the list.
barcodes.remove_description: Scanning this code will no longer find the product.
barcodes.none: No barcode yet. Scan the pack or generate one.
barcodes.generate_hint: Kadai creates a shop barcode (starting with 20) you can print on labels.

hints.requires_prescription: Billing asks for the doctor’s prescription.
hints.serial_tracked: Billing asks for the serial number of each piece.
hints.loose: Weighed / measured at the counter, no brand pack.

schedule_help.OTC: Over the counter — no prescription needed.
schedule_help.G: Schedule G — sell under medical supervision.
schedule_help.H: Schedule H — sell only on a doctor’s prescription.
schedule_help.H1: Schedule H1 — prescription needed and the sale is entered in the H1 register.
schedule_help.X: Schedule X — prescription kept with you and a separate register.

variants.values_placeholder: Type a value and press Enter
variants.preview_empty: Pick sizes and / or colours to see what will be created.
variants.prices_hint: Leave blank to use the product’s selling price.
variants.add_more_hint: Sizes and colours already made are filled in. Add new values — only the missing combinations are created.
variants.create_hint: They are created right after you save the product.
variants.parent_barcodes_note: Barcode {{codes}} will be removed from this product — each size / colour gets its own barcode.

products.search_placeholder: Search name, Tamil name or scan barcode
products.create_with_code: Add a new product with this barcode
products.empty_description: Add products one by one, or import your full list from Excel in a few minutes.
products.empty_tip: Tip: keep a barcode scanner connected — scanning a pack finds or adds the product instantly.
products.no_match_hint: Check the spelling, try the Tamil name or clear the filters.

bulk.description: Tick what you want to change. Other details stay the same.
bulk.percent_hint: Use minus for a price cut (−5).
bulk.amount_hint: Use minus for a price cut.

categories.description: Group products for search, reports and default GST. Up to 3 levels (Grocery › Rice › Ponni).
categories.delete_description: Only an empty category can be deleted.
categories.in_use_description_one: It has {{count}} product or sub-categories. Deactivate it instead? Existing products keep it.
categories.in_use_description_other: It has {{count}} products or sub-categories. Deactivate it instead? Existing products keep it.
categories.empty_description: Create groups like Grocery, Oil, Snacks — search and reports get easier.
categories.parent_hint: Leave empty for a main category.
categories.tax_defaults_hint: New products in this category start with these values.

brands.description: Brands help search, offers (e.g. 10% off Aachi) and brand-wise sales reports.
brands.add_placeholder: Type a brand name and press Enter
brands.duplicate: A brand with this name already exists.
brands.delete_description: Only a brand without products can be deleted.
brands.in_use_description_one: {{count}} product uses this brand. Deactivate it instead?
brands.in_use_description_other: {{count}} products use this brand. Deactivate it instead?
brands.empty_description: Add the brands you sell — Aachi, Sakthi, Ponvandu…

tax_rules.description: For clothes and footwear the GST rate depends on the price of each piece — e.g. up to ₹2,500 → 5%, above → 18%.
tax_rules.editor_hint: Slabs go from the lowest price up. The last slab covers every higher price.
tax_rules.fix_slabs: Fill every slab to check prices.
tax_rules.delete_description: Products using it would lose their price-based GST.
tax_rules.in_use_description: {{products}} products and {{categories}} categories use it. Switch it off instead?
tax_rules.empty_description: Needed only for textiles and footwear. Other shops can skip this.
tax_rules.how_it_works: Billing uses the price after discount for each piece. Prices that include GST are checked at the slab’s own rate.

promotions.description: Discounts, buy-X-get-Y and combo prices are applied automatically at billing.
promotions.editor_hint: Billing applies the offer automatically when the bill qualifies.
promotions.empty_description: Create a Deepavali sale, “Buy 2 get 1” or a combo price — billing applies it by itself.
promotions.name: Offer name
promotions.reward_different_hint: e.g. buy toothpaste, get a brush.
promotions.targeting_hint: Pick products, categories or brands. For all sizes of a dress, pick its category or brand.
promotions.exclude_placeholder: Add a product to leave out
promotions.end_hint: Last day of the offer (empty = no end)
promotions.days_hint: Leave all off for every day.
promotions.priority_hint: When offers compete, the higher number wins.
promotions.stackable_hint: Otherwise only the best offer applies.
promotions.fill_rules: Fill in the offer details to see the explanation.
promotions.example_bill: Example: a bill of {{bill}} → {{off}} off, customer pays {{pays}}.
promotions.delete_description: An offer already used in bills is switched off instead.
promotions.switched_off: Offer “{{name}}” was used in bills, so it was switched off

labels.description: Print barcode stickers with name, price and MRP — on a label printer roll or an A4 sticker sheet.
labels.add_placeholder: Search or scan a product to add
labels.empty_description: Scan a product — scanning it again adds one more label.
labels.template_hint_roll: Barcode label printer (one label per row)
labels.template_hint_a4: Normal printer with A4 sticker sheets
labels.generate_missing: Make barcodes for products without one
labels.generate_missing_hint: Saved to the product, so scanning works at billing.
labels.missing_barcodes_one: {{count}} product has no barcode — tick “Make barcodes” to print one.
labels.missing_barcodes_other: {{count}} products have no barcode — tick “Make barcodes” to print them.

import.description: Bring your product list from Excel, Tally or another billing software in a few steps.
import.step_template_hint: Fill one product per row. Keep the first row (column names) as it is.
import.step_upload_hint: A CSV file (from Excel: Save as → CSV UTF-8). Files with more than {{rows}} rows are imported in the background.
import.mode_upsert_hint: Matching products get the new prices and details.
import.drop: Click to choose a file, or drop it here
import.step_check_hint: Kadai checks every row first. Nothing is saved yet.
import.check_waiting: Upload a file to check it.
import.error_rows_one: {{count}} row has problems — fix them in the file and upload again, or import the other rows.
import.error_rows_other: {{count}} rows have problems — fix them in the file and upload again, or import the other rows.
import.failed: The import stopped. Please check the file and try again.

store_prices.description: Set a different selling price or MRP for a branch. Empty = the product’s normal price.
store_prices.discard_confirm: Your changes for this branch will be lost.

files.file_type: This file type is not supported.
files.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.

validation.unit_unknown: Choose a unit from the list.
validation.scale_plu_format: Scale code must be digits only (up to 10).
validation.barcode_checksum: This barcode’s last digit is wrong — please scan it again.
validation.barcode_or_generate: Type a barcode or choose Generate.
validation.mrp_below_sale_price: Selling price is more than the MRP.

validation.category_cycle: A category cannot be placed under itself.

validation.slab_last_unbounded: The last slab must cover every higher price.

validation.variant_duplicate_value: The same value is entered twice.

validation.label_copies_limit: At most 5,000 labels at a time.
validation.empty_patch: Nothing to save — no changes made.
validation.reference_not_found: The selected item no longer exists — please choose again.
validation.kind_change: This product type cannot be changed.
validation.variant_axes_mismatch: Use the same kinds (size / colour) as the existing variants.

validation.import_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows (50,000 maximum).
validation.barcode_qty_whole: Box quantity must be whole pieces.
